dsa.prompt: Given an array of integers and a target, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target. Assume exactly one solution exists.
expected_points: Brute force O(n^2) first, then improve
Single pass with a hash map of value -> index

dsa.prompt: Given a string containing only the characters ()[]{}, decide whether the brackets are balanced and correctly nested.
expected_points: Use a stack of open brackets
Match each closing bracket with the top of the stack
Empty string and odd length cases

dsa.prompt: Reverse the words in a sentence in place, e.g. 'the sky is blue' becomes 'blue is sky the'. Handle extra spaces sensibly.
expected_points: Reverse the whole string, then each word
Or split and join if in-place is not required

dsa.prompt: Find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
expected_points: Hash map of last seen index to jump the left pointer
Edge cases: empty string, all same characters

dsa.prompt: Given a list of meeting time intervals, merge all overlapping intervals and return the result.
expected_points: Merge when the next start <= current end
Touching intervals and fully contained intervals

dsa.prompt: Given a grid of '1' (land) and '0' (water), count the number of islands. Islands connect horizontally and vertically.
expected_points: DFS or BFS from each unvisited land cell
Mark visited (in place or a set)
Recursion depth risk; iterative BFS as alternative

dsa.prompt: Design a structure that returns the median of a stream of numbers after each insertion.
expected_points: Two heaps: max-heap for the lower half, min-heap for the upper half
Rebalance so sizes differ by at most one

dsa.prompt: Given two words, compute the minimum number of insertions, deletions and substitutions to turn one into the other (edit distance).

system_design.prompt: Design a URL shortening service like bit.ly.
expected_points: Requirements: create, redirect, custom aliases, expiry, analytics
Short code generation: counter + base62 or hashing, collision handling
Storage choice and partitioning by code

system_design.prompt: Design a rate limiter that an API gateway can use to limit each user to N requests per minute.
expected_points: Algorithms: token bucket, fixed/sliding window and their trade-offs
Shared state in Redis with atomic operations
Where it sits: gateway vs service
Failure mode if Redis is down (fail open vs closed)

system_design.prompt: Design the home feed for a social network with 50 million daily users.
expected_points: Fan-out on write vs on read, hybrid for celebrities

system_design.prompt: Design a one-to-one and group chat service like WhatsApp.
expected_points: Message storage, ordering and delivery receipts
End-to-end encryption at a high level

system_design.prompt: Design a distributed job scheduler that runs millions of scheduled tasks per day reliably.
expected_points: Task storage indexed by next run time
Leasing/locking so each task runs once
Retries with backoff and dead-letter handling
Horizontal scaling of workers and partitioning

system_design.prompt: Design search autocomplete that returns the top suggestions for each prefix in under 100 ms.
expected_points: Trie or prefix index with precomputed top-k
Caching at the edge for popular prefixes

behavioral.prompt: Tell me about a project you're proud of and the part you personally owned.
expected_points: Clear context and their specific role

behavioral.prompt: Tell me about a time you had to learn something new quickly to get the job done.
expected_points: Why it mattered and the time pressure
How they apply that learning now

behavioral.prompt: Describe a time you disagreed with a teammate or manager about a technical decision. What happened?
expected_points: How they made their case with data

behavioral.prompt: Tell me about a time something you shipped went wrong in production.
expected_points: What changed afterwards to prevent it (growth mindset)

behavioral.prompt: Tell me about the toughest feedback you've received. What did you do with it?
Describe a time you had to work with another team that had different priorities.
Tell me about a time you had to deliver with unclear requirements and changing priorities.
Tell me about a time you influenced a decision without having formal authority.
expected_points: The decision and why it mattered
How they built a case and allies
